description:
Honor Mobile Services
Honor’s alternative to Google Play Services. Needed to access advanced Honor features.
A Honor ID is required to access services, like Themes. This may break an app like InPost Mobile, see:
https://github.com/0x192/universal-android-debloater/issues/477
See more about Honor Mobile Services: https://www.xda-developers.com/huawei-hms-core-android-alternative-google-play-services-gms/
